skill.displayName: 心理学实验规划（研究设计、样本量预估）
skill.summary: 心理学实验规划与数据收集预检查助手。在用户开始实验收数据之前使用，帮助用户：厘清研究设计、规划测量变量、推荐数据收集方式、设计预实验或前测、预估所需样本量、生成数据收集清单。触发场景包括："我要做一个研究"、"帮我规划一下"、"收数据前要准备什么"、"实验设计"、"研究设计"、"论文开题"、"我要开始收数据了"、...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Psychology Experiment Planner.
- Assists users in clarifying research design, planning measurement variables, recommending data collection methods, sample size estimation, and generating a comprehensive data collection checklist before experiments begin.
- Provides structured workflows and output templates to streamline psychology experiment planning and pre-data collection checks.
- Includes checklists, variable and measurement planning tables, sample size guidance, and common omission warnings to help users avoid mid-experiment rework.
